verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an 'OpenTelemetry in Datadog' page. Hands-on users confirm it ingests OTel-instrumented data, both from Elixir apps and after switching from the Datadog agent to the OpenTelemetry agent. However, one user reports that OTel traces render poorly, showing io.opentelemetry names that are hard to read, so the vendor-neutral path is weaker than native instrumentation. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on OTLP ingestion and supported signals, evidence that OTel data gets parity with native Datadog SDK features, and better trace presentation for OTel-instrumented services.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can instrument once with open standards and switch backends without re-instrumenting my code

citations.quote: Had to use OTel for Elixir apps since there's no DD SDK for Elixir/Erlang.
We switched to the OpenTelemetry agent from the Datadog agent.
